cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Give me the actual note, not your description.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can read it to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I want the words that don't get your emphasis.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me the one line you're using to decide for me.

mechanism: A corrects a helper's mixture of quoted condition and opinion to obtain direct access to a consequential note.
confusable: General curiosity is insufficient; the note must enable A's next decision, and S03 should distinguish source from interpretation.
comparison: Private personal note access differs from checking club financial source documents.
seedUse: Use actual note versus emphasized description; establish the decision and conditional line rather than unspecified information.
